parse.title: Fremennik Diary
parse.wikitext:
==Medium==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Fremennik" data-diary-tier="Medium"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Slay a [[Brine rat]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Olaf's Quest]]
*{{SCP|Slayer|47|link=y}}
*[[Weaponry]], and a [[spade]] to enter the [[Brine Rat Cavern]]
|-
|2. Travel to the [[Snowy Hunter Area]] via [[Eagle transport system|Eagle]].
''Note: You'll unlock travel from the [[Eagles' Peak Dungeon]] after the required quest.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Eagles' Peak]]
*[[Rope]]
|-
|3. Mine some [[coal]] in [[Rellekka]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Fremennik Trials]]
*{{SCP|Mining|30|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]] (can be found north of the [[Rellekka mine]])
|-
|4. Steal from the [[Rellekka]] [[Fish stall]]s.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Fremennik Trials]]
*{{SCP|Thieving|42|link=y}}
|-
|5. Travel to [[Miscellania]] by [[Fairy ring]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Fremennik Trials]] and having started [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen]]
*[[Dramen staff|Dramen]] or [[Lunar staff]] to travel to [[Fairy ring]] code {{Fairycode|cip}}
|-
|6. Catch a [[Snowy knight]].
|
*{{SCP|Hunter|45|link=y}}
*{{SCP|Hunter|35|link=y}} with a [[butterfly net]] and [[butterfly jar|jar]]
|-
|7. Pick up your [[Pet Rock]] from your [[POH]] [[Menagerie]].
''Note: You need to use your [[pet rock]] on a [[pet house]], then retrieve it off the ground. You cannot be in [[building mode]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[The Fremennik Trials]]
*{{SCP|Construction|37|link=y}}
*30,000 [[coins]], 4 [[oak plank]]s, [[saw]], and [[hammer]] to construct a [[menagerie]] with a [[Menagerie#Pet house|pet house]], if you haven't already
*[[Pet rock]]
|-
|8. Visit the [[Lighthouse]] from [[Waterbirth island]].
''Note: You must exit the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon]] on the 5th sublevel.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Horror from the Deep]]
*[[Food]] and {{SCP|Prayer|43|link=y}} for [[protection prayer]]s recommended
*Way of getting past the two-man doors at the [[Waterbirth Island Dungeon|dungeon]] entrance (help from another player, [[pet rock]] and [[rune thrownaxe]]s, or {{SCP|Agility|85|link=y}} {{Boostable|y}} for the [[Rocks (Waterbirth Island)|rock shortcut]])
|-
|9. Mine some [[gold]] at the [[Arzinian mine]].
''Note: This task is automatically completed during [[Between a Rock...]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Partial completion of [[Between a Rock...]] 
*{{SCP|Mining|40|link=y}}
*{{SCP|Defence|30|link=y}}
*Any [[pickaxe]] and the [[gold helmet]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Fremennik sea boots 2]]:
**Three daily teleports to the [[Rellekka]] marketplace
*[[Antique lamp (medium)|Antique lamp]] worth 7,500 experience in any skill of at least level 40
*10% increased chance of gaining approval in [[Managing Miscellania]] when fishing or woodcutting (other activities always give approval){{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1295656001136480256|date=18 August 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/102109|archivedate=18 November 2022|quote=For Fishing & Woodcutting, approval tends to be given as a random chance of an increase; the 10% or 15% buff may not make much visible difference. And for the other skills, approval had a 100% chance of being given, so the buff is immaterial.|name=miscapprove}}
*[[Fossegrimen]] will [[enchanted lyre(i)|imbue your lyre]] with infinite charges for 600 of each required fish, down from 800
